{{Quote|Devil Squadron's a volunteer force, Holt–we pave the way for Grace Command's supply missions out here.|Jenn Devaad|<ref name="Knight Errant: Deluge 1">[[Knight Errant: Deluge 1|''Knight Errant: Deluge'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Devil Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron that were a military branch of [[Grace Command]]. They were a volunteer mission that operated during the years of the [[New Sith Wars]] when the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] was not combating the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on some of the conquered worlds. This squadron operated by paving the way for the relief mission from Grace Command that dropped in food as well as medical supplies to affected areas. The squadron was equipped with [[Fire Lotus-class starfighter]]s.

During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Dark Age|Dark Age]], the squadron was led by [[Jenn Devaad]] who led a mission to strike against [[Aquilaris]]; a [[Daimanate]] world that was besieged by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord [[Zodoh]]. Devil Squadron successfully managed to repulse their enemy and made contact with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kerra Holt]].
